Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Westminster for 2026, and here is what he found: 10 family events, 6 of them free. New this round are Santa's Storytime and Cocoa at Little Monkey Bizness on December 3, Santa Visits at Westminster City Hall from December 6 to 11 and the Santa Send-Off Party on December 23, alongside the holiday lighting ceremony at City Hall and several Santa photo spots. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
